But if you do good and fear Allāh - then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

4:129.text: And you will never be able to be equal
between wives, even if you should strive
and fear Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

4:131.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And We have instructed those who were given the Scripture before you and yourselves to fear Allāh. But if you disbelieve - then to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allāh Free of need and Praiseworthy.

4:132.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

4:133.text: If He wills, He can do away with you, O people, and bring others
. And ever is Allāh competent to do that.

4:134.text: Whoever desires the reward of this world - then with Allāh is the reward of this world and the Hereafter. And ever is Allāh Hearing and Seeing.
